## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD6: Existing callers that read review.max_resolution_attempts at runtime (sprint SKILL.md Step 1, debug-everything, fix-bug, review workflow) verified to use the new key
- DD3: All callers audited: a grep for max_resolution_attempts in .claude/, plugins/dso/, dso_ci_review/ returns zero hits in code files (skills, scripts, hooks, Python); comments and docs updated separately

## Overview
Bulk rename of all `review.max_resolution_attempts` references to `review.max_cycles` across all instruction/workflow/skill/docs files. These are all instruction documents (non-executable) — per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5, existing tests remain valid (GREEN mode). No new behavioral code.

## File Impact (all instruction docs — still-valid per Rule 5)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md: 3 occurrences (lines 13, 1199, 1202)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md: 2 occurrences (lines 101, 221)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/TEST-FAILURE-DISPATCH.md: 6 occurrences (lines 33, 89, 128, 142, 194, 223)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md: 1 occurrence (line 126)
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: 1 occurrence (line 1816)
- plugins/dso/skills/oscillation-check/SKILL.md: 2 occurrences (lines 84, 85)
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md: 1 occurrence (line 397)
- .claude/skills/skill-refactor/SKILL.md: 1 occurrence (line 398)
- CLAUDE.md: 3 occurrences (lines 57, 84, 127)
- docs/designs/test-failure-subagent-strategy.md: 3 occurrences (lines 41, 118, 185)

## Implementation
For each file, replace every occurrence of review.max_resolution_attempts with review.max_cycles.
In REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md line 1202, also update the shell variable assignment:
  FROM: MAX_ATTEMPTS=$("$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso" read-config.sh review.max_resolution_attempts)
  TO:   MAX_ATTEMPTS=$("$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso" read-config.sh review.max_cycles)
In REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md line 13, update the config reference comment:
  FROM: - `review.max_resolution_attempts` (default: `5`) — max autonomous fix/defend attempts before escalating to user
  TO:   - `review.max_cycles` (default: `4`) — max autonomous fix/defend attempts before escalating to user
In CLAUDE.md line 57, update the config keys list pointer (this updates the pointer text only — doc-router Gate 5 compliance: CLAUDE.md may contain config key names in the pointer list).

NOTE: This task does NOT touch the test files (handled by T1) or the schema (handled by T3) or the config/validate scripts (handled by T4).

## ALSO UPDATE default value references
The old default was 5; the new default is 4 (per epic SC2). Update all "(default: 5)" references to "(default: 4)" for review.max_cycles.

## Codebase Green Invariant
After this task lands:
- All doc references use the new key name
- The read-config.sh shim (T2) ensures the new key resolves correctly at runtime
- The config files (T4) already set the new key
- Zero references to old key remain in doc files (except as historical notes in comments if needed)

## Consumer Detection Pass
All files listed are instruction documents. The REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md line 1202 is the only executable shell snippet — that call is updated from the old key to new key. The read-config.sh shim (T2) would have handled the old key, but direct update is cleaner.

## Zero-hit Verification
After this task + T3 + T4, the following grep should return zero code-file hits:
  grep -r "max_resolution_attempts" plugins/dso/ .claude/ --include="*.sh" --include="*.py" --include="*.conf" --include="*.json"

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] No max_resolution_attempts in script/config/schema files
  Verify: grep -r "max_resolution_attempts" plugins/dso/ .claude/ --include="*.sh" --include="*.py" --include="*.conf" --include="*.json" | grep -v "^Binary" | wc -l | grep -qE '^0$'
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md uses new key in shell snippet
  Verify: grep -q 'read-config.*review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md config reference section uses new key
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] sprint SKILL.md uses new key
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] oscillation-check SKILL.md uses new key
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/skills/oscillation-check/SKILL.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md config keys section uses new key name
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' CLAUDE.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
